system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"hi! I haven’t had an email reminder about Spotify charging my student account the full £9.99 and they have, help I can’t afford it"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! I totally understand your concern. You can check your subscription status and see if manual verification is needed at <URL>. Let us know how it goes!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Doesn't address refund or financial concern."}
